item.title: MLA MY Tarigami chairs Environment Committee meeting

item.title: Winter Session of Lok Sabha ends; key Bills passed, debates see politically-charged attacks
item.description: NEW DELHI: (Dec 19) Lok Sabha was adjourned sine die on Friday, drawing curtains on the 19-day-long Winter Session of Parliament which saw the passage of crucial Bills, including one to repeal the 20-year-old MNREGA and another on opening up the civil nuclear sector for private participation. item.title: 35-year-old man found Dead in Baramulla
item.description: A 35-year-old carpenter was found dead under mysterious circumstances in the Goushbugh area of Pattan in north Kashmir’s Baramulla district on Friday morning, triggering concern among locals and prompting an immediate police response. The deceased has been identified as Javid Ahmad Mir, son of Ghulam Mohammad Mir, a native of Khamooh, Rafiabad. item.description: A man was detained at Srinagar International Airport on Friday after he was found travelling on a fake air ticket, officials said.An official stated that the incident occurred early in the morning at the airport’s drop gate, where the individual was intercepted while travelling from Srinagar to Delhi. item.title: FIR filed after illegal quarrying triggers Landslide in Baramulla
item.description: SRINAGAR: Police in north kashmir’s Baramulla have registered a case after a landslide struck the Khanpora area yesterday late night, an incident attributed to illegal stone quarrying that loosened the hillside and sent debris cascading down the slope. item.title: Police seize Eagle Posters, book two under UAPA in South Kashmir
item.description: SRINAGAR: Police in Heerpora area of South Kashmir’s Shopian district have arrested two individuals for allegedly possessing eagle posters and booked them in FIR No. 73/2025 under Section 13 of the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act (UAPA). Officials identified the arrested persons as Ahsan Ahmad Wagay, a resident of Yarikha Kulgam, and Rahil Ahmad Bhat, a resident of Lasio Bonpora Kulgam.
